scope: Actual built x86 instructions; mocked kernel services and serialized wait. No scheduler, interrupts or Windows runtime tested.

tests.test: Uncontended acquire/release, owner, IRQL, stack and preserved registers
Try-acquire succeeds and preserves caller APC level through release
Failed try leaves ownership/count intact and restores caller IRQL
Contended acquire records contention and waits on correct event
Release wakes a waiter with priority boost before lowering IRQL
IoAssignDriveLetters stdcall export forwards to fastcall dispatch with correct stack cleanup
IoReadPartitionTable stdcall export forwards to fastcall dispatch with correct stack cleanup
IoSetPartitionInformation stdcall export forwards to fastcall dispatch with correct stack cleanup
IoWritePartitionTable stdcall export forwards to fastcall dispatch with correct stack cleanup
KeTryToAcquireQueuedSpinLock free UP exclusion uses raised IRQL without a kernel helper
KeTryToAcquireQueuedSpinLockRaiseToSynch free UP exclusion uses raised IRQL without a kernel helper
